prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Interactive flow additions produced the largest wins (up to +14.8%), though predictions were sometimes too optimistic as recent flow tests caused severe drops (down to -10.2%).
Step reordering generated strong wins (up to +12.0%), but carries high risk, frequently failing, showing no clear effect, or causing significant negative impacts (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state indicators produced solid wins (up to +6.1%), sometimes exceeding predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2% predicted), though others showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates achieved selective wins (+3.5% and +6.7%), but follow-up copy tweaks showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns, layout changes, standalone preview screens, hints, and notifications failed to produce any wins, with redesigns (down to -19.3%) and hints (down to -3.1%) often causing significant performance declines.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: +1.8% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +9.0% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -12.5% over 3 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +6.1% over 1 test(s)

- choose_path, hint: -3.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

- finish, new_screen: -2.5% over 1 test(s)

- home, new_flow: +1.5% over 2 test(s)

- sign_in, reorder: +0.4% over 8 test(s)

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Companion Voice Pitch Flow: Add an interactive vocal pitch selector component during pet selection so users can test and choose their pet's audio personality. (why: Adoption stage has a high drop-off (77.1%) and median duration of 89s; interactive customization flows drive high engagement.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Stage Progress Bar: Display a multi-stage render progress indicator showing asset loading and desktop canvas binding on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has an 84.9% conversion rate with a 201s median wait; 3 support tickets reported pet rendering and visibility issues.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Tray Control Simulator Screen: Insert a new interactive screen simulating system tray controls (hiding, summoning, and messaging the pet) before final completion. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on desktop.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Account Pet Retrieval Copy: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly assure returning users that signing in restores existing saved pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Desktop Orientation Layout: Transform the final intro screen into a high-contrast spotlight layout highlighting main desktop controls. (why: Finish stage drop-off is 73.5% with a long mean duration; high-contrast spotlight design improves retention of key shortcuts.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Availability Hint: Add an explicit safety hint on the sign-in screen explaining account backup protection. (why: Address top user support complaint (8 emails) regarding lost or reset pets during sign-in.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Completion Toast Notification: Enable desktop readiness alert notification switch on the waiting screen to ping users when pet creation completes. (why: Mean waiting time is 2336s; users tab away and need an alert cue when the pet is ready on desktop.)
